reference_answer:
## Review scope
Final evidence-only audit of the supplied tender requirements and bid package before the 15 September 2026, 17:00 IST deadline. No unstated requirement is assumed.

## Compliance checklist
| # | Check | Evidence | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BOQ quantity | Technical and Financial bids both state 100 | PASS |
| 2 | Delivery | Tender requires 30 days; technical offer says 45 days | FAIL — delivery mismatch |
| 3 | Price separation | ₹69,44,300 appears in TechnicalBid.pdf | FAIL — price disclosed in technical bid |
| 4 | Financial total | FinancialBid.pdf total is ₹69,44,300 | PASS |
| 5 | BOQ arithmetic | Supplied evidence says totals match | PASS |
| 6 | Form A signature | Form A is signed | PASS |
| 7 | Form A stamp | Company stamp is absent | FAIL — missing company stamp |
| 8 | Power of attorney | Signed and notarised | PASS |
| 9 | Technical file format | TechnicalBid.pdf is PDF | PASS |
| 10 | Technical file size | 12.4 MB against 10 MB maximum | FAIL — file exceeds 10 MB |
| 11 | Financial file | FinancialBid.pdf is PDF and 2.1 MB | PASS |
| 12 | DSC | Class 3 DSC valid through 30 November 2026 | PASS |
| 13 | File separation | Separate technical and financial PDFs exist | PASS, subject to removing price disclosure |
| 14 | Upload proof | Not available before upload | PENDING |
| 15 | Stamp duty | Amount not specified in tender | NOT SPECIFIED |

## Blocking defects
1. Delivery mismatch: 45 days offered versus the required 30 days.
2. Missing company stamp on Form A.
3. Price disclosed in technical bid: ₹69,44,300 must remain exclusively in FinancialBid.pdf.
4. TechnicalBid.pdf file exceeds 10 MB at 12.4 MB.

## Corrections and re-check
Revise delivery to 30 days only if operationally approved; otherwise escalate as a compliance blocker. Stamp Form A. Remove all price content from TechnicalBid.pdf and regenerate it below 10 MB without harming legibility. Then re-check quantity 100, both totals, signatures, notarisation, file separation, filenames, virus scan, DSC signing, and finally capture upload hashes and portal acknowledgement. Three years of audited statements are not mandatory in the supplied tender, and stamp duty is not stated as mandatory.

## Submission verdict
NO-GO. Do not submit until all four blocking defects are corrected and independently re-checked. After correction, an authorised human reviewer must approve the package and confirm successful portal upload before the deadline.
